description: NZ Bridge Centrelines (Topo, 1:50k) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Topographic Office. A structure erected over a depression or obstacle to carry traffic or some facility such as a pipeline. Data Dictionary for bridgecl: topo. linz. govt. nz/data-dictionary/tdd-class-bridgecl. html This layer is a component of the Topo50 map series. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher National Topographic Office. Its tags are New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2026-04-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
